claims: Reid Wiseman's late wife was Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman.
Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman was known as Carroll.
Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman was a pediatric nurse practitioner.
Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman passed away on May 17, 2020.
Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman passed away at age 46.
Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman passed away after a five-year battle with cancer.
Reid Wiseman and Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman had two daughters, Ellie and Katherine.
In April 2026, the Artemis II crew honored Anne Carroll Taylor Wiseman by requesting a moon crater be named "Carroll".
According to NASA and her obituary, Carroll Wiseman previously worked in the newborn intensive care unit.
Carroll Wiseman is survived by Reid Wiseman and their two daughters.
During the Artemis II mission in April 2026, crewmate Jeremy Hansen announced the dedication of a bright, newly identified crater near the moon's Glushko crater to honor Carroll Wiseman's memory.
Carroll Wiseman encouraged Reid Wiseman to continue his astronaut career during her illness.
